title: ChatGPT launches
summary: OpenAI opens ChatGPT to the public as a free research preview. The starting gun for everything on this page.

title: Perplexity answer engine launches
summary: An AI search engine that answers with cited sources goes live a week after ChatGPT.

title: GPT-4
summary: OpenAI releases GPT-4, a big jump in reasoning over the model behind the original ChatGPT.

title: Claude launches
summary: Anthropic releases the first public version of Claude the same day as GPT-4.

title: Google Bard opens to the public
summary: Google's chatbot opens to users in the US and UK. It is renamed Gemini in February 2024.

title: Showdigs Listing Shield
summary: AI-powered detection of fake rental listings, plus ID and face checks before self-guided tours.

title: Claude 2
summary: Anthropic's second-generation model, with a much longer context window for working with documents.

title: DoorLoop Looper AI
summary: A free ChatGPT-powered real estate Q&A chatbot. One of the first generative AI launches from a PM software company.

title: My interview with AppFolio's Head of AI
summary: I sat down with Cat Allday, AppFolio's Head of AI, on my podcast to talk through AppFolio's AI roadmap, months before Realm-X was announced.

title: AppFolio unveils Realm-X
summary: Billed as the first generative AI conversational interface in property management software. Piloted with select customers.

title: Gemini 1.0
summary: Google announces Gemini, its first natively multimodal model family.

title: Rentvine's first AI feature
summary: Generative AI rewrite for property listing descriptions, with thumbs-up/down feedback.

title: Claude 3 family
summary: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus launch as Anthropic's first three-tier model lineup.

title: GPT-4o
summary: A faster multimodal model with real-time voice, made available to free ChatGPT users.

title: Lula launches Foresight
summary: An AI-powered work order platform with AI triage, scoping and an assistant for maintenance coordinators.

title: Realm-X beta expands, Flows piloted
summary: AppFolio widens the Realm-X beta and pilots Realm-X Flows, AI-assisted workflow automation.

title: OpenAI o1 (reasoning models)
summary: The first model trained to think before answering, kicking off the reasoning-model era.

title: Realm-X generally available
summary: Realm-X rolls out to AppFolio customers at FUTURE 2024. AppFolio reports users saving 10+ hours a week.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
summary: Anthropic open-sources MCP, a standard way to connect AI assistants to the software and data you already use. It becomes the plumbing for every connector later on this timeline.

title: Gemini 2.0
summary: Google's second Gemini generation, built for the "agentic era" with native tool use.

title: Property Meld acquires Mezo
summary: Property Meld buys Mezo and its AI virtual maintenance technician, MAX, which handles resident intake, troubleshooting and triage. I covered it in a special edition the same day.

title: Lula raises $28M Series A
summary: Led by PeakSpan, with a large share earmarked for AI and the Foresight platform.

title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
summary: Anthropic's first hybrid reasoning model, plus a preview of Claude Code, its agentic coding tool.

title: OpenAI adopts MCP
summary: OpenAI adds MCP support, turning Anthropic's protocol into a cross-industry standard.

title: Claude 4 (Opus 4 and Sonnet 4)
summary: Anthropic's models built for long-running agent work and coding.

title: Lula + Rent Manager AI maintenance integration
summary: Lula's AI triage and dispatch plugs directly into Rent Manager work orders.

title: AppFolio Realm-X Performers
summary: AI agents for leasing and maintenance that handle inquiries, schedule showings, diagnose requests from photos and create work orders.

title: GPT-5
summary: OpenAI's next flagship becomes the default model in ChatGPT.

title: TenantCloud launches Cloudia
summary: An AI listing assistant that turns a few property details into a polished rental listing.

title: Buildium Lumina AI Workforce
summary: Five AI agents for maintenance, leasing, accounting, resident experience and business operations, built into Buildium.

title: DoorLoop AI Assistant
summary: An AI assistant for every DoorLoop customer that handles tenant requests, automates admin work and surfaces insights.

title: Zillow app inside ChatGPT
summary: Zillow becomes the only real estate app in ChatGPT at launch, rentals included. Renters can now search listings from inside a chatbot.

title: RentRedi AI onboarding
summary: Upload leases and AI extracts tenants, rents and terms to set up the account automatically.

title: Buildium cuts off Vendoroo's access
summary: Buildium temporarily blocks Vendoroo, an AI maintenance coordinator, from shared customers' accounts. The first public fight over who gets to plug AI into PM data.

title: AppFolio Performance Platform
summary: AppFolio relaunches as an AI-native platform under the banner Real Estate Performance Management, with three Realm-X Performers.

title: Rentvine acquires RentFinder.ai
summary: Adds AI rent pricing and comps inside Rentvine.

title: RentEngine AI
summary: One AI leasing agent that answers calls and texts, schedules showings and escalates to the team.

title: Rent Manager Orion AI
summary: Built-in AI for report summaries, call summaries, writing help, translation and smart bills, receipts and bank sync.

title: Gemini 3
summary: Google's next flagship model, rolled into Search and the Gemini app.

title: Showdigs Tori AI leasing assistant
summary: A customizable AI leasing assistant for single-family property managers.

title: DoorLoop AI Inspections
summary: Guided photo capture with AI-organized reports, issue flagging and work-order creation.

title: Tenant Turner AI Virtual Agent (beta)
summary: An AI agent that handles lead conversations and books showings.

title: ShowMojo AI Virtual Agent (beta)
summary: An AI agent (later named Mo) that answers rental inquiries by chat and text, qualifies prospects and schedules showings.

title: 2026 PM Trends Report
summary: Jordan Muela and I unveiled the 2026 PM Trends Report (Harris Poll, 500 small landlords) at the NARPM Broker/Owner closing keynote. 75% of owners plan to use AI to find their next property manager, and 74% are comfortable with AI handling PM tasks.

title: Rentvine MCP (beta)
summary: The first single-family PM software platform to adopt MCP, so AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT can query live Rentvine data. Announced at Be Herd 2026, in beta.

title: LeadSimple AI Agent (early access)
summary: AI voice handling and optional AI text replies for Phone and Inbox, guided by each company's instructions and knowledge base.

title: Findigs raises $32M Series C
summary: Funding for Findigs' automated screening and rental decisioning platform.

title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
summary: Anthropic's first generally available Mythos-class models.

title: AppFolio Realm-X connector for Claude
summary: An agent-to-agent connector lets property managers direct work in AppFolio from Claude, inside AppFolio's permissions. Announced the same day Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.

title: AppFolio deepens agentic AI
summary: A multilingual Leasing Performer, automated bill processing and an AI resident concierge.

title: My new rule for AI announcements
summary: I stopped covering AI announcements that don't include both availability and pricing. I called out AppFolio, Entrata, Obligo, Rently and Rentvine, and pointed to Rent Manager's Orion AI as the right way to do it.

title: Snappt AI fraud detection inside AppFolio
summary: Snappt's AI document fraud detection gets embedded in AppFolio's FolioScreen Trusted Renter screening.

title: RentEngine MCP
summary: A full-access MCP so Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants can pull comps, review applicants and schedule showings from RentEngine data.

title: Boom raises $15M, launches BoomCRM
summary: Boom, which started in tenant screening and rent reporting, raises a Series A to build a single-family leasing operating system and launches an AI leasing assistant that answers calls 24/7 and books tours.

title: Rentvine Vinnie AI support agent
summary: A 24/7 in-app AI support agent for Rentvine customers, with handoff to a human.

title: GPT-6 Astra (limited rollout)
summary: OpenAI begins rolling out GPT-6 to approved organizations first, with cybersecurity guardrails.

title: 2026 AI in Property Management Report
summary: Our Crane survey of 280 property managers found Claude is the AI daily driver for 46% of PMs versus 35% for ChatGPT. Only 2% said cost is their biggest barrier.

title: Rentvine Fixie AI maintenance assistant
summary: Residents describe a problem by text, voice, photo or video; Fixie troubleshoots and writes the work order if needed.

title: ShowMojo AI outbound voice agent
summary: Built with Super, it calls and texts new leads within five minutes and books tours.

title: The PM Software API Report Card
summary: I launched a free report card grading property management software APIs, including how ready each one is for AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT.

title: The new Realm-X, standard for every customer
summary: At FUTURE 2026, AppFolio makes the new Realm-X and the Claude connector available on all plans. It says Realm-X AI actions are up sevenfold year over year.

title: Frontier AI labs start buying PM operating data
summary: I reported on AI data firms micro1 ($1B) and Mode ($5B) offering to buy company operational data, property management included, to train AI. I'm not selling mine.

title: Rentvine MCP goes live for all customers
summary: Rentvine says its MCP is in beta now and going live for all customers later this year, included in every plan.

title: Rentvine Pro Skills agent workforce
summary: Previewed at Be Herd 2026: AI agents that work across the whole Rentvine platform.

expected: Around late November 2026, then about every six months
title: API Report Card: first re-score
summary: Scores get re-run about 60 days after launch, then roughly every six months.

title: More Orion AI features
summary: Rent Manager lists Express Help Summaries, History and Notes Summaries, and an AI Script Builder as coming soon.

title: Foxen AI for PetClear
summary: Foxen says AI functionality is coming to PetClear, its pet screening product, in 2026.

title: ChatGPT API (gpt-3.5-turbo)
summary: OpenAI lets developers plug the model behind ChatGPT into their own apps at a tenth of the price of its earlier models. This is the API that the first wave of AI features in business software, including property management tools, was built on.

title: xAI announces Grok
summary: Elon Musk's xAI introduces Grok, a chatbot with real-time access to posts on X, as an early beta for a limited group of X users.

title: GPT-4 Turbo and custom GPTs
summary: At its first DevDay, OpenAI releases GPT-4 Turbo with a much longer memory and lower prices, and lets anyone build custom versions of ChatGPT (GPTs) without code. Many businesses built their first in-house assistant this way.

title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
summary: A mid-priced Claude model that beats Anthropic's own top model and is free to try on Claude.ai, launched alongside Artifacts. It made Claude a favorite for writing and coding.

title: Grok-2
summary: xAI releases Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini in beta on X, its first models to compete near the top of public leaderboards.

title: Grok 3
summary: xAI's model trained on its Colossus supercomputer adds step-by-step reasoning and briefly leads public rankings, putting Grok in the same conversation as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro
summary: Google's first 2.5 model debuts at number one on the LMArena leaderboard, the point where Google caught up with OpenAI and Anthropic.

title: Image generation in ChatGPT (GPT-4o)
summary: ChatGPT can now create accurate, photorealistic images with readable text. The viral "Studio Ghibli" trend that followed brought a flood of new users to ChatGPT.

title: Grok 4
summary: xAI releases Grok 4 with built-in tool use and live search, plus a Heavy version in a new top-priced subscription tier.

title: Nano Banana image editing in Gemini
summary: Google's new image model (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, nicknamed Nano Banana) lets anyone edit photos by describing the change. It went viral and pulled millions of new users into the Gemini app.

title: Claude Opus 4.5
summary: Anthropic's top model gets cheaper and better at coding and agent work. Paired with Claude Code, it set off a holiday wave of non-programmers building their own software.

title: GPT-5.5
summary: OpenAI's strongest GPT-5 update, built to take a messy multi-step task and carry it through: research, spreadsheets, documents and code.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash
summary: Announced at Google I/O, Gemini 3.5 Flash becomes the default model in the Gemini app and in AI Mode in Search worldwide, putting a stronger agent-ready model in front of billions of people.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
summary: Opus 5.5 delivers roughly Fable 5.1-level work at a lower price, followed six days later by a faster, cheaper Sonnet 5.5 (and Haiku 5.5 in October). This put near-top performance into the models most people use every day.

title: Gemini 4 Argon
summary: The first model in Google's Gemini 4 generation becomes available to developers and to paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and Search.

title: OpenPhone launches its public API
summary: OpenPhone, now Quo, opens a public REST API to all customers for automated texts and syncing contacts and conversation data.

title: Xero open-source MCP server
summary: Xero releases an official open-source MCP server for its accounting API, so AI assistants can read and create contacts, invoices and reports in a Xero file.

title: QuickBooks app live in ChatGPT
summary: The QuickBooks app goes live in ChatGPT for US users, able to analyze a business's QuickBooks data and produce profit and loss and cash flow statements.

title: Zoom connector for Claude
summary: Zoom releases an MCP connector in Claude's directory that gives Claude access to Zoom meeting summaries, transcripts, recordings and scheduling.

title: QuickBooks connector in Claude
summary: Intuit's QuickBooks connector arrives in Claude's directory for all Claude users, analyzing QuickBooks data and generating financial statements in chat.

title: Quo joins Claude's connector directory
summary: Quo says it is the first business phone system in Claude's official connectors directory. Claude can read call and text history, update contacts and send texts from a Quo number.

title: Xero connector live in Claude
summary: Xero's integration with Claude goes live, letting Xero subscribers bring live accounting data such as overdue invoices and cash position into Claude conversations.

title: RingCentral connectors for Claude and ChatGPT
summary: RingCentral releases MCP connectors for Claude and a ChatGPT plugin that expose voice, SMS and chat data, available with paid RingEX plans.

title: AppFolio launches the Realm AI suite
summary: AppFolio groups its AI tools under the Realm brand and adds its first large language model features, starting with AI-written unit and property marketing descriptions. A conversational interface is piloted with a small group of customers.

title: AppFolio Max plan adds read/write Database API
summary: AppFolio's new top-tier Max plan, launched in early 2024, gives large operators read and write access to their AppFolio database through the Database API. The Plus plan gets read-only access.

title: Rentvine AI Assistant
summary: A voice or text assistant inside Rentvine that records receipts, adds vendor bills and creates tenant charges from a spoken or typed command. Included in Rentvine's single plan.

title: Rent Manager Smart Bills
summary: AI reads PDF and image invoices, including ones vendors email to a dedicated inbox, and creates draft bills for review. A licensed add-on, later grouped under the Orion AI brand.

title: DoorLoop 2.0
summary: DoorLoop rebuilds its platform from the ground up and pitches it as agentic property management software, with AI agents running inside the same system. Now available to all customers.

title: Revela AI (controlled beta)
summary: Revela opens a controlled beta of Revela AI: alerts and recommendations first (late rent, overloaded vendors), with an in-app AI agent and SmartTasks, and automation planned for later stages.

title: Rentec Direct AI Listing Generator
summary: Rentec Direct adds a GPT-3.5 powered tool that writes rental listing descriptions from a property's stored details. One of the earliest generative AI features in small-landlord PM software.

title: Rentec Direct AI invoice and receipt scanner
summary: AI extracts and categorizes data from photographed or uploaded receipts and invoices so expenses can be posted from the mobile app.

title: Rentec Direct Open API goes live
summary: A read/write REST API with granular key permissions, included at no extra cost for Rentec Direct Pro and PM clients. Rentec pitches it for AI-driven automations through tools like Tasklet and Zapier.

title: Yardi Smart AP for Breeze Premier
summary: AI and OCR invoice processing for Yardi Breeze Premier: invoices are emailed or uploaded, the key fields are extracted, and bills land in Breeze for review and approval. Included at no extra cost.

title: MagicDoor launches as AI-native PM software
summary: A new full PM platform for small landlords, billed as the first AI-native property management software, launches at $2.50 per unit per month with over $2M in pre-seed funding.

title: MagicDoor raises $4.5M seed
summary: An oversubscribed seed round co-led by Okapi Venture Capital and Shadow Ventures to expand MagicDoor's AI-first platform for leasing, rent, maintenance dispatch and compliance.

title: MagicDoor MCP server
summary: A read-only, open-source MCP server lets Claude and other MCP clients answer questions from live MagicDoor data, using permission-scoped API keys. Included with every plan; ChatGPT not yet supported.

title: LeadSimple Maintenance AI (preview)
summary: AI triages maintenance requests sent by text: it summarizes tenant texts and photos, flags missing details and prepares the work order for a person to review. In preview for eligible maintenance numbers.

title: LeadSimple opens public API docs and self-serve keys
summary: LeadSimple publishes its REST API reference publicly and lets admins create named, read-only or read/write API keys per integration. API access previously had to be switched on by support.

title: Aptly MCP server
summary: Aptly offers an MCP server so assistants like Claude and ChatGPT can read and act on Aptly boards, inboxes and knowledge. Earliest dated mention is a June 2026 Aptly webinar on using it.

title: Process Street launches Process AI
summary: Process Street adds ChatGPT-powered AI that generates workflows and checklists from a prompt and can run AI steps like summarizing, translating and formatting inside a process.

title: Process Street MCP server
summary: A first-party MCP server exposes most of Process Street's API as tools, so AI assistants can start workflow runs, assign tasks and report on data sets. Available on all plans.

title: Follow Up Boss pulls call recordings and texts from its API
summary: Zillow-owned Follow Up Boss stops returning call recordings and text message content through its API, leaving only metadata. Integration partners, including the AI assistant HouseWhisper, lose access.

title: Follow Up Boss Smart Messages
summary: AI-suggested text and email replies built into the Follow Up Boss inbox and lead profile, drafted from each lead's recent activity and past conversations. Available to all accounts on desktop.

title: ShowMojo and Tenant Turner add Property Shield fraud detection
summary: Both PropertyTek leasing platforms integrate Property Shield, which uses AI to scan listing sites, social platforms and marketplaces for fake ads, duplicate listings and brand impersonation, then flags threats inside the leasing dashboard.

title: Tenant Turner opens its API to all customers
summary: Tenant Turner releases a revamped API in its customer portal, free for every customer, with self-serve documentation formatted for both developers and AI agents. The launch is pitched at property managers vibe-coding their own tools.

title: RentEngine open API
summary: RentEngine documents a self-serve open API, with keys generated in a developer portal and access included in the subscription. It later becomes the base for the RentEngine MCP. Earliest dated first-party mention; the API may be older.

title: Rently launches Ria AI leasing agent
summary: Ria, built on the Rently Intelligence platform first previewed in Nov 2025, answers prospects by text and email, pushes them to book self-guided tours and re-engages no-shows. Single-family customers get it from June 15, 2026, with multifamily expected in Q4 2026.

title: Showdigs AI Identity Verification
summary: Showdigs replaces Listing Shield with pay-per-use AI Identity Verification, which matches a prospect's government ID to live selfies before a tour, plus free monitoring of Craigslist and Facebook for scam listings.

title: Showdigs AI Leasing Agent takes over lead management
summary: The agent expands beyond tour booking to qualify leads over text and transcribed phone calls, answer property questions and hand tricky conversations to the team inbox with full context.

title: Boom public API docs
summary: Boom's public developer docs describe REST APIs for its BoomScreen tenant screening and BoomReport rent reporting products. Earliest archived copy found; the API may be older.

title: Boom's first AI agent: Application Support
summary: Boom launches an AI agent that watches rental applications around the clock, spots what is blocking each applicant and helps resolve it so applications reach a decision instead of stalling.

title: Property Meld AI Communication Suite
summary: Property Meld ships AI Translate (eight languages for residents and vendors), AI Message Assist for drafting replies and AI Summary for condensing work order threads, included for standard package customers.

title: Property Meld TrueCost, powered by MAX
summary: Property Meld begins rolling out TrueCost, which uses its MAX AI and maintenance data to estimate repair costs at diagnosis, supply market pricing for owner conversations and automate cost capture and billing.

title: Vendoroo unveils agents beyond maintenance
summary: Vendoroo unveils three new AI agents at NARPM Broker/Owner covering owner communication, vendor coordination and front-office support, alongside its existing in-PMS assistant and resident-facing maintenance agent.

title: Vendoroo joins Rent Manager's integrations program
summary: Vendoroo's AI front desk and maintenance coordinator becomes an approved Rent Manager integration, six months after Buildium temporarily blocked its access to shared customers.

title: Latchel AI phone intake
summary: Calls to Latchel-assigned maintenance lines are now answered by an AI intake system that handles routine and emergency requests 24/7, with a live person available within 60 seconds.

title: Latchel MCP for Claude and ChatGPT
summary: Latchel releases an MCP connector that lets property managers read and act on work orders, tasks and conversations from Claude or ChatGPT, signed in with their own Latchel login.

title: Latchel Autopilot AI
summary: Latchel launches Autopilot AI, an upgraded tier with AI on every resident and vendor message, outbound voice AI, smart estimates, warranty management and preventative maintenance. New features are free during the rollout.

title: Mason API goes self-serve with write access
summary: Mason, an AI maintenance coordinator, ships v3 of its external API with self-serve read-only and read-write keys, plus endpoints to create and update work orders, approve estimates and invoices, and book visits.

title: FixGrid publishes API v1
summary: FixGrid, a multifamily maintenance platform, publishes a public REST API covering tickets, units, turns, inspections and vendors, with signed webhooks and a dated changelog.

title: RentSpree Rental assistant
summary: RentSpree adds an AI Rental assistant for landlords that answers tenant questions from the lease, captures and diagnoses maintenance requests, and books a Lula or Thumbtack pro once the landlord approves the quote. Earliest dated mention is its terms, effective Sep 8, 2026.

title: AppFolio sues Beagle and cuts off its access
summary: AppFolio sues Beagle, a renters insurance compliance vendor, and moves to shut off the logins Beagle used inside customers' AppFolio accounts; Beagle countersues a week later. It is the biggest legal fight yet over how outside vendors, and the AI agents that work the same way, get into PM data.
